latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Video YouTube — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling users to turn uploaded photos into YouTube-ready videos with music and transitions, rendered on the cloud.
- Supports major image formats (JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP) with uploads up to 500MB, and generates 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Automatic connection setup with anonymous token support (100 free credits, 7-day expiry) for quick start.
- Flexible prompt system routes user commands to actions like upload, export, credits check, and status updates.
- Full cloud-based workflow: no installation needed, fast GPU rendering, and API-driven video editing.
- Designed for creators who want to make YouTube videos from photos without traditional video editing skills.
